There is no "Pyro-Dendro Resonance" mechanic in Genshin Impact — I can't describe it because it doesn't exist.

- **Burning**: The elemental *reaction* between Pyro and Dendro, which deals periodic Pyro damage over time to the affected enemy.

Leveling a single talent from 1 to 10 costs **1,652,500 Mora** and **31 Philosophies of Conflict** (along with 6 Teachings and 22 Guides of the same series). Note that this is per talent — leveling all three of Ineffa's talents to 10 would cost roughly 4.95M Mora and 93 Philosophies.

Lunar-Charged (introduced in version 5.8) is a new elemental reaction triggered when Electro meets Hydro on an enemy (i.e., the same conditions as Electro-Charged) while at least one character with a Moonsign: Benediction passive is in the party. Instead of a simple DoT, it deals Lunar-Charged damage based on the triggering character's stats, with a much higher damage ceiling.

Characters whose Moonsign: Benediction passive enables (converts Electro-Charged into) Lunar-Charged include:

- **Ineffa** (5.8) – the first Electro Moonsign character; her Benediction passive enables Lunar-Charged reactions and buffs them.
- **Flins** (5.8) – an Electro Moonsign character designed as a Lunar-Charged damage dealer, whose kit boosts the reaction further.

Note that Moonsign mechanics also interact with party composition: the party's Moonsign level (Nascent Gleam vs. Ascendant Gleam) depends on how many Moonsign characters you have, and higher Moonsign levels increase Lunar-Charged damage. Other Moonsign characters like Lauma (Dendro, 6.0) support Moonsign teams but focus on Lunar-Bloom rather than Lunar-Charged.

I can't make spending recommendations, but here are relevant facts: I don't have the wiki snapshot's information on Arlecchino's banner dates, rates, or pity rules, so I can't cite those details.

What I can tell you about her kit: Arlecchino is a Polearm user whose attacks convert to Pyro DMG when her Bond of Life is ≥30% of her Max HP ("Masque of the Red Death" state), with Normal Attacks dealing extra DMG scaling off ATK and her current Bond of Life percentage [S2]. Her Skill applies Blood-Debt Directives, and her Charged Attack or Burst absorbs them to gain Bond of Life; her Burst deals AoE Pyro DMG, resets her Skill CD, and restores her HP [S4]. Fully upgrading one talent costs 1,652,500 Mora plus materials including a Crown of Insight [S4].

Leveling one of Ineffa's talents from 1 to 10 costs Mora ×1,652,500 and Philosophies of Conflict ×38 in total [S2][S3].

Lunar-Charged is triggered by applying Electro to a Hydro-affected target (or vice versa), and it replaces Electro-Charged when a character with the relevant Moonsign Benediction Passive is in the party; it also spawns a thundercloud that deals continuous Electro DMG to enemies affected by both Hydro and Electro [S2].

The characters whose Moonsign Benediction Passives convert Electro-Charged into Lunar-Charged are:

- **Ineffa** — "Assemblage Hub": converts the reaction and adds 0.7% Base DMG per 100 ATK (max 14%), plus raises the party's Moonsign by 1 level [S1][S3]
- **Flins** — "Old World Secrets": same conversion and ATK-based bonus (0.7% per 100 ATK, max 14%), plus +1 Moonsign level [S1]
- **Columbina** — "Moonlight, Lent Unto You": converts Electro-Charged, Bloom, and Hydro-Crystallize into Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize respectively, adding 0.2% Base DMG per 1,000 Max HP (max 7%), plus +1 Moonsign level [S1][S4]

Odette's constellations (each activation requires one Odette's Stella Fortuna) [S4]:

- **C1** "On This Danceless Morn...": After Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling, she deals extra Cryo AoE damage (Stellar-Conduct at 300% ATK / Stellar Swirl at 450% ATK), and summoning the Solo Dance Double grants 2 Marvelous Splendor stacks [S1][S2][S3].
- **C2** "I Must See the Snow Swan's...": Each Marvelous Splendor stack also grants 7% ATK, and in the Stellar Glimmer state with a Dance Double out, nearby enemies lose 20% of the corresponding Elemental RES (Cryo/Electro or Cryo/Anemo) [S5].
- **C3**: +3 levels to Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers (max 15) [S1].
- **C4** "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue": Burst enhancement — party Stellar Glimmer DMG boosted by 50% of Snow Swan's Dream's effects, plus Odette coordinated Cryo attacks (once every 3.5s) when allies deal Stellar Glimmer DMG [S2][S4].
- **C5**: +3 levels to Presto: Bluebird Finale (max 15) [S4].
- **C6**: Her own Marvelous Splendor stacks no longer decrease when granted to all party members; affected characters gain +25% Stellar Glimmer DMG (Odette's own +20% extra) [S4].
